Name: Fishing Perfection Helper
Author: ForgetfulDoryFish
Description:
If keeping track of the fish you haven't caught yet for perfection is annoying, this is the mod for you. This mod gives you on-the-spot information about the fish you haven't caught yet that you can catch under the current season, weather, time of day, and map/quest unlocks. Use the V key to open the list of fish to catch (or you can configure this to a different key with the optional Generic Mod Config Menu). The list is sorted by difficulty (easiest to hardest) and gives you the names and generalized information about the locations at which to catch the fish. 

If there aren't any fish you still need that are catchable right then, the mod will instead list all the fish you're missing according to season, in order to help you plan ahead.
